verdict.rationale: Pigment's own marketing says the product is 'easily integrated through native connectors, open APIs, and scheduled imports,' which is a first-party claim of a public API. It is only a thin, glancing mention: no API reference or endpoint documentation appears, and probes for an OpenAPI spec all returned 404. The Audit Trail API only exports logs to a SIEM, and the MCP server belongs to a separate story, so neither counts toward driving the product through a public API. Missing for 10: published API reference docs, an OpenAPI spec, documented endpoints for reading and writing models and data, auth and usage docs for the API, and independent or hands-on corroboration.
